summary: Comprehensive testing of KB route changes and full-page editor. KB now at / (homepage), Portal at /portal, KB Editor at /dashboard/kb-editor. All 19 backend API tests passed. All frontend routing tests passed. KB Homepage (PublicDocs) loads with 5 top nav tabs, sidebar navigation, search (Cmd+K), TOC, prev/next navigation. Tab navigation correctly updates sidebar and navigates to first article in each tab. Direct URL routing (/docs/:slug) works with graceful fallback for nonexistent slugs. Portal routes at /portal, /portal/categories, /portal/login, /portal/submit all working. Protected routes (/dashboard, /dashboard/kb-editor) correctly redirect to login.
